decision_cruda.rationale: LH-02 is down (radio and CMMS agree), and the likely repair is 13:30. The Este mine has no loader, and its trucks have spare capacity (72 t/h against 0 inflow). LH-10 is idle at the workshop, 0.49 h from TJ-E569-07, so it takes no production or development from anywhere. It would arrive about 10:00 and load at 27.5 t/h. The 164 t at 10.5 g/t is about 55 oz and can be cleared before 17:00. No other loader is moved, because that would cost its home place production or development value.

Keep LH-10 at E569-07 (158 t at 10.5 g/t, LH-02 down until ~13:30). LH-01 down at C564-14 (317 t at 10.7 g/t, about 109 oz). Lend LH-08 from the cheap preparation heading (1.3 oz/h); 0.33 h travel. It loads about 25 t/h for about 6.5 h, so about 165 t and 57 oz, against about 9 oz of development lost. Net is about +48 oz. Central stockpile has room (234/450), so the small truck limit is not binding. I did not take LH-09 (critical path, 4.2 oz/h). Radio and CMMS agree on both failures, so no confirmation is needed. Nothing is freed for reserves.

Radio and CMMS agree on all three failures, so no confirmation is needed. No free loader exists. LH-09 is on a critical-path heading worth 4.2 oz/h, so it stays. Norte is already truck-limited: 66 t/h of truck capacity against 244 t in the stockpile plus 581 t of ore in its stopes, so a loader for N600-11 adds nothing. Central is also truck-limited, but LH-08 (1.3 oz/h at home) is loading the highest-grade ore at C564-14 (10.7 g/t), so I keep it there. Este is not truck-limited (28 t/h inflow against 72 t/h), so LH-10 keeps mucking E569-07 (10.5 g/t, 153 t). There is no stopped stope, so no reserve can be activated. I keep both existing loans and make no changes.
